title: Do Better Managers Bribe Less? Cross-National and Experimental Evidence
Who Pays for Tariffs Along the Supply Chain
Regulating Conglomerates: Evidence from an Energy Conservation Program in China
abstract: We study a prominent energy regulation affecting large Chinese manufacturers that are part of broader conglomerates. Using detailed firm-level data and difference-in-differences research designs, we show that regulated firms cut output and shifted some production to unregulated firms within their conglomerate instead of improving their energy efficiency. To account for conglomerate and market spillovers, we interpret these results through the lens of an industry equilibrium model featuring conglomerate production. The policy raises welfare if the per ton benefits of carbon reduction exceed $161. Alternative policies that exploit public information on business networks can increase aggregate energy savings by 10 percent. (JEL D22, L22, L51, L60, P28, P31, Q48)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一项对中国大型制造企业影响深远的能源监管政策，这些企业隶属于更大的企业集团。利用详细的企业层面数据和双重差分研究设计，我们发现受监管企业削减了产量，并将部分生产转移至其集团内未受监管的企业，而非提高能源效率。为考虑集团内及市场间的溢出效应，我们通过一个包含集团生产的行业均衡模型来解释这些结果。若每吨碳减排的效益超过161美元，该政策将提高社会福利。利用公开的商业网络信息的替代政策，可将总体节能量提高10%。（JEL D22, L22, L51, L60, P28, P31, Q48）

title: The Role of Industrial Policy in the Renewable Energy Sector
venue: Environmental & Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: Renewable electricity generation technology costs have fallen dramatically, investment has grown rapidly, and renewables are now a pillar of climate and decarbonization policy. Part of the credit for these trends goes to environmental policy efforts to support renewable energy as a substitute to fossil energy. The recent rise in protectionism, industrial policy, and geopolitical tensions has the potential to either undermine or enhance these environmental policy objectives. In this paper, we provide an overview of renewable energy economics and policy, with a focus on solar and wind power. We outline theoretical rationales for industrial policy and review recent empirical research, paying particular attention to how renewable energy policies have generated spillovers across firms and countries. We close by highlighting how this recent evidence can inform ongoing industrial policy debates. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 可再生能源发电技术成本大幅下降，投资快速增长，可再生能源如今已成为气候和脱碳政策的支柱。这些趋势的部分功劳归于环境政策对可再生能源作为化石能源替代品的支持。近来保护主义、产业政策和地缘政治紧张局势的加剧，既可能削弱也可能增强这些环境政策目标。本文概述了可再生能源经济学与政策，重点关注太阳能和风能。我们阐述了产业政策的理论依据，并回顾了近期的实证研究，尤其关注可再生能源政策如何在企业和国家之间产生溢出效应。最后，我们指出这些最新证据如何为当前正在进行的产业政策辩论提供参考。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文，无需额外付费。

title: Firm Selection and Growth in Carbon Offset Markets: Evidence from the Clean Development Mechanism in China
abstract: We study carbon offsets sold by firms in China under the Clean Development Mechanism (CDM). We find that offset-selling firms, meant to cut carbon emissions, instead increase them by 49% after starting an offset project. In a model of firm investment decisions and offset review, we estimate that CDM firms increase emissions due to both the selection of higher-growth firms into projects (35 pp) and because offset projects themselves boost firm growth and therefore emissions (14 pp). The CDM reduces global surplus by causing damages from increased emissions four times greater than private gains from trade in the offset market. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了中国企业在清洁发展机制（CDM）下出售的碳抵消额。我们发现，本应减少碳排放的抵消额出售企业，在启动抵消项目后，排放量反而增加了49%。在一个关于企业投资决策和抵消项目审核的模型中，我们估计CDM企业增加排放的原因有两个：一是高增长企业选择进入项目（35个百分点），二是抵消项目本身促进了企业增长，从而增加了排放（14个百分点）。CDM导致的排放增加所造成的损害，是抵消市场中私人贸易收益的四倍，从而降低了全球社会总剩余。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可在 www.nber.org 免费下载本文，无需额外付费。

title: Market Congestion and Information Frictions on Global E-Commerce Platforms
Strategic Avoidance and the Welfare Impacts of U.S. Solar Panel Tariffs
abstract: This study examines the effects of tariffs imposed by the U.S. on imported solar panels. We first provide clear evidence that tariff-exposed firms shifted production to locations that did not face tariffs, and that domestic prices increased relative to other markets. We then develop a structural model to analyze welfare effects. We find that the tariffs generated modest gains for domestic manufacturers and for government revenues, but larger losses in domestic consumer surplus and environmental benefits, thereby reducing domestic welfare. Furthermore, the tariffs reduced domestic solar industry employment and wages. By contrast, subsidizing solar panel manufacturing could increase domestic production, employment, and welfare.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了美国对进口太阳能电池板加征关税的影响。我们首先提供了明确证据，表明受关税影响的企业将生产转移至未被征税的地区，且国内价格相对于其他市场有所上涨。随后，我们构建了一个结构模型以分析福利效应。我们发现，关税为国内制造商和政府收入带来了适度收益，但国内消费者剩余和环境效益的损失更大，从而降低了国内福利。此外，关税减少了国内太阳能产业的就业和工资。相比之下，对太阳能电池板制造进行补贴可能会增加国内产量、就业和福利。

Industrial Energy Regulation: The Role of Business Conglomerates in China
abstract: This paper characterizes the importance of ownership networks of firms that are subject to a prominent energy regulation in China: the Top 1000 Enterprises Energy-Saving Program. We use data on the activities of regulated and unregulated firms that are part of the same conglomerate to study the overall importance of conglomerates as well as their geographic concentration. Accounting for business networks of regulated firms significantly increases the fraction of output that is affected by the regulation. We also document that most related firms of Top 1000 firms are located in the same province.
abstract_zh: 本文刻画了一项中国重要能源监管政策所涉企业的所有权网络的重要性，该政策即“千家企业节能行动”（Top 1000 Enterprises Energy-Saving Program）。我们利用同属一个企业集团的受监管企业与未受监管企业的经营数据，研究企业集团的总体重要性及其地理集中度。考虑受监管企业的商业网络，会显著提高受该监管影响的产出比例。我们还发现，千家重点企业的大多数关联企业位于同一省份。

title: How Costly are Restrictions on Size
Two-Sided Search in International Markets
When Food Gets Political: How Does News Drive Green Food Offerings
abstract: We study how social media publicity affects the early-stage adoption of sustainable food technologies by local businesses.  Understanding this connection is challenging because of the lack of empirical measurement of local business decisions at scale and, more importantly, the endogeneity of social media publicity to unobserved local demand shocks. Focusing on the case of impossible meat products, we devise a unique location-specific adoption metric based on social media announcements between 2015 and 2019. We propose a novel identification strategy that leverages the quasi-random variations of county-quarter-level news production for different topics to causally identify the linkage between social media publicity and adoption. We find that local news coverage of impossible meat products increases local restaurants' and stores' adoption of the focal green food technology. Notably, the social media news effect on adoption is higher among more liberal regions, and news content about producer financials was the main contributor to identifying the causal effect of news on local businesses' adoption of impossible meat products.
abstract_zh: 我们研究社交媒体宣传如何影响当地企业对可持续食品技术的早期采用。由于缺乏对大规模地方企业决策的实证测量，且社交媒体宣传本身内生于不可观测的当地需求冲击，理解这一联系颇具挑战。以“Impossible Meat”（不可能肉）产品为例，我们基于2015年至2019年的社交媒体公告，设计了一个独特的地点特定采用指标。我们提出了一种新颖的识别策略，利用不同主题在县-季度层面的新闻产出中的准随机变化，来因果识别社交媒体宣传与采用之间的联系。我们发现，当地对不可能肉产品的新闻报道提高了当地餐厅和商店对该绿色食品技术的采用。值得注意的是，社交媒体新闻对采用的影响在较为自由派的地区更高；关于生产商财务状况的新闻内容，是识别新闻对当地企业采用不可能肉产品的因果效应的主要贡献因素。
